statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitor) was ordered
Diagnosis codes I48.0 and I34.0 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is medically necessary to document correlation between symptoms and cardiac rhythm
